messages:
Maya: Heads-up — we start the quiet window in 30m, want to lock pins for runtime+router and kick a small canary.
Alejandro: I can pin runtime to v2.14.1 now. Router needs v3.0-rc2 pinned (header-split change).
Sam: Console team: we need the feature-flag roll in place so we can do a 10% soft-slice before full shift. Also want a rollback checklist ready.
Maya: Agree. I will update release notes and add rollback steps. Link: https://confluence.redwood/release/1732468001 (WIP) :memo:
deploy-bot: deploy-bot scheduled rollout: runtime=v2.14.1, router=v3.0-rc2, console=no-change. Canary plan: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% every 5m.
Nate: Ops oncall: if canary fails, start immediate rollback. Command to abort/rollback: `deploy-bot abort --id=1732468001` or `deploy rollback runtime v2.13.9`
Alejandro: Note: runtime kernel swap (kv-cache-opt) might add ~10-20ms p95 initially while caches warm. Monitor `/dash/runtime-p95` and `/dash/router-latency`.
Sam: Canary gates: error-rate <0.5% and p95 latency <100ms. If either breaches for 2 consecutive minutes -> fail.
Maya: Ok, pinning done. Runtime pinned -> v2.14.1, Router pinned -> v3.0-rc2. Adding note in release: "router header split; pin required until 3.0 stable"
deploy-bot: Rolling canary: phase=10% (started). Observability hooks enabled.
Rachel: Added release notes paragraph about customer-impact and mitigation steps. Also attached quick rollback commands and who to @ for rollback.
Maya: Canary reports — slight error bump on runtime at +6m (0.7%). Alej, any ideas?
Alejandro: Checking logs — a small thrift timeout from router side on header parsing. Looks like an edge case with old client header.
Sam: We're seeing console-side errors correlated with the same times. Feature flag off for the 10% slice?
Maya: Flip the feature flag to disable header-split on the slice. `ff toggle header_split --off --target=10%`
deploy-bot: Canary progression paused at 10%.
Nate: Given error bump and correlation, we should rollback runtime and router for safety. Ops will execute rollback in 2m unless someone objects.
Alejandro: I agree. Rollback runtime->v2.13.9 and router->v2.9.7.
Sam: Console OK with rollback. Rachel: update release notes to mark aborted canary and follow-up fix.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated by Nate. Actions: runtime -> v2.13.9, router -> v2.9.7. Canary aborted.
deploy-bot: rollback completed. Traffic restored to previous baseline.
Maya: Thanks all. Filing a short postmortem and follow-up tasks: 1) add header parsing guard in router, 2) improve canary gating to catch header-timeouts earlier, 3) rehearse pin/unpin flow in runbook.
Rachel: I'll create the postmortem doc and link it to the release notes.
Nate: Ops: marking incident as mitigated and updating oncall logs.
Maya: Closing thread — we'll re-schedule the rollout once fixes land and do a smaller internal canary first. :lock:
